title: Zootopia. Judy the rabbit.
lines: On a little farm where carrots grow lives a bunny.
Her name is Judy Hopps.
Judy has long grey ears and big purple eyes.
She has lots and lots of brothers and sisters.
Two hundred and seventy-five of them!
All the rabbits in her family become carrot farmers.
But not Judy.
Judy wants to be a police officer.
In the big city of Zootopia.
Her mum and dad are worried.
Judy, they say, there's never been a rabbit police officer.
Rabbits are too small.
But Judy says: Then I'll be the first!
Zootopia is a crazy city.
All the animals live there together.
Big animals and small animals.
Elephants and mice.
Lions and sheep.
There's a part with snow and ice for the polar bears.
There's a part with hot sun for the camels.
There's a part with rain and jungle.
And there's a tiny little town for the mice.
Judy goes to police school.
It's very hard.
The other officers are big.
Rhinos, elephants, tigers.
Judy falls in the mud.
She slips on the ice.
But she doesn't give up.
She practises and practises.
And at the end she's the best in the whole class!
Judy becomes a police officer.
She gets a blue uniform and a badge.
She's so proud.
But on her first day she gets a boring job.
She has to write parking tickets.
The boss, a big buffalo, thinks a rabbit can't do anything else.
Judy writes two hundred tickets before lunch.
But she wants a real case.
Then a lady otter comes to the police.
My husband has disappeared, she cries.
His name is Mr Otterton.
Nobody is looking for him.
Judy says: I'll find him!
The boss is angry.
All right, he says.
You have two days.
If you don't find him, you're out.
Judy needs help.
She asks a fox.
His name is Nick.
Nick is a clever fox, but also a bit of a trickster.
He makes money with sneaky tricks.
At first he doesn't want to help.
But Judy is clever.
She says: If you don't help, I'll give you a ticket!
Nick sighs.
Okay, okay.
I'll help you.
They search together.
They go to an office where only sloths work.
Sloths are very, very slow.
The sloth who helps them is called Flash.
It takes him ten minutes to tell a joke.
Judy almost goes crazy waiting.
Nick laughs his head off.
They follow clue after clue.
Through the snow, through the jungle, through the mouse town.
They become friends.
Judy learns that Nick isn't as bad as everyone thinks.
When he was a little fox, he was always bullied.
Everyone said foxes can't be trusted.
So he just became sly.
But deep inside, Nick is kind.
And Nick learns that Judy is brave, and clever, even though she's small.
They find Mr Otterton!
And they find lots of other missing animals too.
They had been put under a spell with a strange blue flower.
That flower made them wild.
Someone wanted to make the animals scared of each other.
So they wouldn't be friends anymore.
Judy and Nick find out who it is.
It's the sweet little sheep from the town hall.
Her name is Bellwether.
Nobody had suspected her!
Judy and Nick set a clever trap.
And they catch Bellwether.
All the animals go back to normal.
Zootopia is saved.
Everyone applauds Judy.
The little rabbit is a real heroine.
And Nick?
Nick goes to police school too.
And he becomes the first fox in the police.
Together with Judy.
Because in Zootopia anyone can be anything.
Big or small, rabbit or fox.
The end.
